All-physical except Mow; Tailwind mode primary; no Trick Room. GAME 1: brought Sneasler/Dragonite/Arcanine/Rotom-Mow (Garchomp+Passimian benched); led Sneasler+Dragonite, Fake Out+Tailwind t1, Sneasler sacks without Protect; Arcanine is mid-game Meta answer (WoW + Intimidate); they doubled Incineroar to remove it early. KEY MATH: Meta immune to Poison Jab; Zen 4x vs Sneasler, 2x KOs Passimian; Ice Punch 4x vs Garchomp/Dragonite. Arcanine Flare Blitz 57-100% vs healthy Mega Meta, never guaranteed OHKO; WoW is the real threat. Mow Tbolt 27-47% vs Meta; Leaf Storm resisted. Scarf Mow eff Spe 174-226: coin-flip vs Meta 178, outspeeds Aero 200 only on high rolls. Meta at -1 w/ TC: Zen ~30-56% vs Arcanine, Ice Punch ~39-74% vs Mow; Aero RS 39-72% vs Arcanine. UNNERVE: Aero on field disables foe Berries; NOTE Sitrus/Lum activate once Unnerve user leaves the field (Arcanine healed after Aero fainted). AERO SYNERGY: Aero immune to Mamo EQ; Wide Guard blocks spreads; weak to Mow Tbolt. SPEED: Aero 200 > Sneasler 189 > Meta 178 > Garchomp 169 > Mow 151 > Arc 147 > Mamo 132. CLEANUP: Mamo Ice Shard (4x) deletes chipped Dragonite/Garchomp; Mamo (Ground) immune to Electric - hard-walls Scarf-locked Tbolt Mow; Thick Fat neuters Arcanine Flare Blitz; keep Mamo healthy for endgame. GAME 2

decisions.rationale: Rotom 1% dies to any Ice move but goes first with Scarf Tbolt vs Mega Meta (24-53%). Arcanine 44% loses to Mamo EQ (50-104% spread) unless Mamo is removed first. Flare Blitz vs Mamo is 57-126% OHKO chance and if Arcanine outspeeds (115 vs 100-132) it prevents EQ entirely, leaving 1v1 vs damaged Meta. ESpeed guarantees move before EQ but never KOs Mamo, so both die. Best win chance is FB Mamo + Tbolt Meta.

Our: Sneasler Jolly Sash FakeOut CC PoisonJab Protect Unburden, Arcanine Careful Sitrus FlareBlitz WoW ESpeed Protect Intimidate, Dragonite Adamant Lum Tailwind ESpeed DragonClaw Protect Multiscale, Rotom-Mow Timid Scarf LeafStorm Tbolt VoltSwitch Trick Levitate. Plan: Intimidate cycle, preserve berries, Trick vs Wash/Mamo, Unnerve blocks Sitrus until Aero removed.

reflections.summary: Preview plan fully validated: the four brought (Mega Metagross/Aerodactyl/Incineroar/Mamoswine) hard-countered their Sneasler/Dragonite/Arcanine/Rotom-Mow line. reflections.adjustment: Expect a game-2 counter-bring of Passimian (Defiant punishes our Intimidate; Close Combat threatens Metagross and Mamoswine) and possibly Garchomp, likely over Sneasler/Dragonite. Keep the same four and Mega Metagross — it outspeeds both and has Zen (2x KO vs Passimian) and Ice Punch (4x vs Garchomp) — but don't lead Incineroar into a likely Passimian, keep Protect-scouting Arcanine's WoW before committing Metagross, and preserve Mamoswine as the Ice Shard answer to Garchomp/Dragonite.

reflections.summary: Lost because preview of Sneasler+Dragonite+Arcanine+Rotom-Mow is double-weak to opp core: Mega-Meta Ice Punch/Zen Headbutt + Aero Rock Slide + Mamo Ice Shard. Dragonite died to Rock Slide + Ice Punch pressure, Sneasler offered no value vs Meta, and Scarf Rotom locked into Thunderbolt was dead into Mamo endgame despite early Incineroar pick with ESpeed.
reflections.adjustment: Don't pair Sneasler and Dragonite vs this Aero/Meta/Mamo. Next game lead Arcanine+Rotom-Mow to Intimidate Meta and OHKO Aero through Sash with Thunderbolt, keep Dragonite in back for Tailwind only after Aero is gone, and never lock Rotom into Thunderbolt while Mamo is unrevealed - use Volt Switch/Trick or Leaf Storm vs Mamo and save Will-O-Wisp for Meta/Mamo not into Protect.
